CREATE FUNCTION triage_score(c case_row) RETURNS int AS $$

       + (CASE WHEN c.prior_police_contact > 1 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END)
       + (CASE WHEN c.weapon_mentioned THEN 60 ELSE 0 END)
       + LEAST(c.days_since_contact, 14) * 2;
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
